title: Hate-CLIPper: Multimodal Hateful Meme Classification based on Cross-modal Interaction of CLIP Features
reasoning: The paper explicitly evaluates its model's performance on religious categories, as 'Religion' is one of the fine-grained protected category labels used in its classification and interpretability analysis. Figures 3 and 4 specifically demonstrate the model's ability to cluster and identify hateful memes targeting religion.
